headline: Protesters hold vigils in 23 cities over housing law in Spain
summary: Protests over an eviction have grown into a national outcry, with vigils held in 23 cities across Spain. The demonstrations are directed at the country's housing law.
why: Housing policy in Spain affects rental markets, property values and lenders. Regulatory changes to tenancy and eviction rules can shift real estate investment conditions.
